usage: Usually means a person who helps someone in a job, office, shop, or project. It often sounds neutral and is very common in workplace settings.
Can be used with a role name before it, like a title or job description, to show what kind of assistant it is.
In daily Cantonese, it often refers to someone supporting a supervisor, manager, teacher, or professional, not just general help.
Learners should note that this word is a normal, practical noun, and it works well in formal and semi-formal business contexts.
